input.quote: (b) Subject to the other terms and conditions of this Agreement (including the licenses and other rights granted under this Agreement or any Ancillary Agreement), each Party shall have the right to exploit, including license, the Joint Program Technology, without a duty of accounting or any obligation to seek consent from the other Party to exploit such Joint Program Technology. To the extent necessary to effect the foregoing in a country other than the United States, each Party grants to the other Party a nonexclusive, irrevocable, perpetual, fully-paid, worldwide license, with the right to grant sublicenses, under the granting Party's interest in Joint Program Technology, for any and all purposes
input.rationale: Article X allocates Program Inventions into Sanofi Sole, RevMed Sole and Joint buckets (defs. 1.103, 1.109 and Section 10.1(a)), and nothing assigns Sanofi background IP, know-how or funded data to RevMed. Where technology is jointly owned, Section 10.1(b) gives each Party an unrestricted right to exploit and license Joint Program Technology without any duty of accounting or consent, backed by a perpetual, irrevocable, fully-paid, worldwide, sublicensable licence outside the US — so the joint-ownership construct sits at or above the preferred position and is not walk-away territory. Third parties performing Collaboration work must assign Program Inventions to the engaging Party (10.1(a)), and any post-signing subcontractor must assign or grant an irrevocable, perpetual, fully-paid, exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide sublicensable licence (Section 3.4/p0259). On the data side, RevMed assigns all Regulatory Approvals, INDs and NDAs for each Product to Sanofi once its Clinical Trials are complete (Section 6.2), Sanofi owns the Product Marks and domain names (10.5), and Sanofi holds sole prosecution control of the Sanofi Prosecuted Patents (10.2(a)) and sole enforcement rights for Product Infringement (10.4(b)). The only licence back to RevMed (Section 3.2) is non-exclusive, royalty-free and limited to performing RevMed's obligations, which is appropriately narrow. Noted but not flagged: the core allocation sentence in Section 10.1(a) is redacted ([***]) in this copy, so the precise Sanofi/RevMed/joint split should be confirmed against the unredacted text before signature.
